mapper.sql: article.article_id, article.article_user_id, article.article_title, article.article_read_count, article.article_comment_count, article.article_like_count, article.article_content, article.article_is_comment, article.article_update_time, article.article_create_time, article.article_summary, article.article_thumbnail, article.article_status, user.user_nickname AS blogger
mapper.update:
update article
article_title = #{articleTitle},
article_content = #{articleContent},
article_summary = #{articleSummary},
article_thumbnail = #{articleThumbnail},
article_is_comment = #{articleIsComment},
article_status = #{articleStatus},
where article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select:
select * from article
and article_title like concat('%',#{articleTitle},'%')
or article_content like concat('%',#{articleContent},'%')
or article_summary like concat('%',#{articleSummary},'%')
where article_user_id=#{articleUserId}

select , t.tag_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_description, c.category_id, c.category_name, c.category_description, c.category_icon, c.category_parent_id, c.category_order from article left join user on article.article_user_id = user.user_id left join article_tag at on article.article_id = at.article_id left join tag t on at.tag_id = t.tag_id left join article_category ac on article.article_id = ac.article_id left join category c on ac.category_id = c.category_id where article.article_user_id = #{articleUserId} order by article.article_create_time desc
